mainEntity.name: What permits are required for basement finishing in cities like Daly City or San Mateo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Basement finishing projects in Bay Area cities such as Daly City or San Mateo typically require several permits to ensure compliance with local building codes. These commonly include general building permits, electrical permits, plumbing permits, and mechanical permits (for HVAC systems). Structural changes, adding egress windows, or creating new bedrooms will require specific approvals. Our team handles the entire permit application process, ensuring all plans meet local regulations before construction begins.
